model.name: H2AIR Integrated Model
model.description: Single-entry H2AIR model with separated user inputs, automatic lifting-surface sizing, measured linear-mass manufacturing model, polar-based airfoils, CAD export, discrete hardware selection and IE-SOAR cross-fuselage cooling integration.

metadata.purpose: Phase-4 aerodynamic/propulsion closure calibrated to the latest accessible H2AIR model output, with lift-prop cruise-state, motor-position and 15-kg VTOL screening.
metadata.evidence_note: Reference drag, wing and legacy propulsion values are source-derived from the latest accessible H2AIR results. Generic propeller maps and unmeasured efficiency/thermal values are engineering assumptions and are never upgraded to supplier-confirmed status.

mission_screen.note: 120-minute total-cycle energy screen. Cruise duration is the remaining time after fixed stages. Transition scheduling becomes physically time-resolved in Phase 5.

wing_sizing.note: Minimum-area screen only. Structural mass and tail/CG must be re-closed in the live source-tree model before geometry release.

metadata.purpose: Time-domain 2-D point-mass VTOL/wing transition and reverse-transition model coupled to the Phase-2 hybrid EMS.
metadata.evidence_note: Phase-4 calibrated drag and mass/wing geometry are inherited. Transition controller gains, CL-alpha/zero-lift angle, powered-lift forward-drag blending, motor time constants and pusher limits remain engineering assumptions until flight/bench data are available.
metadata.fidelity_boundary: This is mission/transition dynamics, not the final 6-DOF flight-control model. Rotational dynamics, control-surface hinge moments, propwash moments and actuator allocation are deferred to Phase 6.

metadata.purpose: Screening-fidelity 6-DOF rigid-body dynamics, trim, control allocation and disturbance testing for the H2AIR-4+1 configuration.
metadata.fidelity_boundary: Aerodynamic derivatives, control-surface effectiveness, servo rates, propeller reaction torque and actuator dynamics are engineering assumptions until identified from CFD, wind-tunnel, supplier or flight-test data. A numerical PASS is a model screen, not flight-release evidence.
metadata.coordinate_frame: Body x forward, y right, z down. Earth frame NED. Phase-3 stations are converted explicitly from nose-to-aft / z-up coordinates.

metadata.purpose: Structural load-case, strength, stiffness and mass-feedback screening for the H2AIR-4+1 UAV using Phase-3 geometry and Phase-6 control-allocation implications.
metadata.fidelity_boundary: Beam/tube calculations are screening fidelity. CFRP is treated as an equivalent isotropic tube material; laminate orientation, joints, inserts, adhesive bonds, printed anisotropy, local buckling, fatigue, impact, vibration and aeroelasticity require supplier data/FEA/test evidence before flight release.
metadata.critical_rule: Strength PASS is not sufficient. Stiffness/deflection is a separate hard design gate. Unknown local mount geometry remains NOT_EVALUATED rather than being assumed safe.

project_targets.warning: These are project/application design targets and preliminary supplier-derived figures, not permission to overwrite supplier-controlled model inputs. Exact accepted hardware data must replace placeholders during Phase 2.

resolution.evidence_note: Neutral-point and geometry mass scaling are screening relations calibrated to the accessible baseline. High-wing layout: fuselage longerons are top+bottom on the centreline; wing Z is auto-set so the TOP longeron boss sits just above the mid-wing primary spar (wing top flush-or-below the fuselage crown); twin booms pass through the wing; HT shares the wing waterline; lift motors sit on the boom tubes under the boom/wing with prop-disk clearance; boom/HT spacing widens only if disk-to-pod clearance requires it. Cruise pusher mounts on the fuselage aft bulkhead. Replace with AVL/CFD/CAD/test correlations before design freeze.

main_wing.note: Screening polar approximating NACA 6415 at Re 2e5 (alpha0~-5, CLmax~1.55 in polar; CLmax_screen 1.37 for area sizing). Replace with measured/XFOIL at flight Reynolds before design freeze.

horizontal_tail.note: Uses the user-supplied XFOIL polar table directly. Values outside the table alpha range are clamped, not extrapolated.

vertical_tail.note: Uses the user-supplied XFOIL polar table directly. Values outside the table alpha range are clamped, not extrapolated.

packaging_layout.note: energy_bay_order: fuel_cell_forward | hydrogen_forward (mode auto sweeps both). cb_battery_order: battery_forward | control_box_forward (X order of CB/battery on the shared top shelf). component_axial_m is the X gap between non-nose components (also sizes FC–H₂ gap when midbody_length_mode is auto). Payload+Cube in nose; CB+battery sit on top in X tandem (first flush with forward energy host front; second axial behind); dual PDBs min-OD searched.

notes: AUTO selection is a database screening step. Final propulsion release requires measured thrust/power/thermal data at the selected voltage and propeller.
Battery current screen conservatively assumes simultaneous maximum lift + pusher database power.
Aircraft bus ceiling is 48.0 V (fuel-cell max); hardware bus_max is capped accordingly (not 12S×4.2=50.4 V).

thermal_screen.source: IE-SOAR is supplier-confirmed air-cooled; 50% efficiency is a screening assumption within the 46-52% family brochure range, not an 800W efficiency map.

fans.source: Preliminary two-fan integration assumption from module imagery. Replace with Intelligent Energy fan/system airflow and allowed external pressure-drop data or bench test.

plenum.note: Required clear air gap between the fuel-cell envelope and inner fuselage skin/shroud. The model reports the minimum fuselage width needed but does not silently widen a hardcoded fuselage.

inlet.note: NACA-style shallow side inlet used as a fan-suction opening in hover. The cooling gate does not credit ram-air recovery.

exhaust.note: Fan-side direct exhaust. Louvre angle is a CAD starting value intended to discourage hot-air recirculation.

cad.note: Drawing-only cooling details exported with the calculated inlet/exhaust positions and flow areas.

optimizer_settings.note: LHS + local-refinement + robust uncertainty selection. target_static_margin is the screening objective aim (SM centering term). Spans from span_bounds when auto. With packaging_layout.enabled, battery/FC/H2 stations are rule-owned and omitted from the search. When packaging energy_bay_order_mode is auto, energy_bay_order_code (0=FC forward, 1=H2 forward) is swept.

user_input_snapshot.notes: 15 kg ceiling screening: areal printed shells (1.8 kg/m2 wing/tails), lighter fuselage fairing kg/m, stepped spar, under-boom props, NACA6415, cruise 18 m/s, span 3.6 m / 0.90 m2, streamlined landing legs + lift-motor fairings.

fuselage.note: cross_section rectangular_filleted: rounded-rectangle midbody with independent width (Y) and height (Z) from packed AABB + wall keepout. diameter_margin_m adds per-side pad so cooling plenums clear the IE-SOAR cross-fuselage gap screen with a centred fuel cell. square_filleted forces W=H. Nose/tail fair from that base to circular tips. diameter_m seed is max(W,H). Fuselage shell kg/m is a light fairing (~1.2 kg/m2 skin) because longerons/frames carry load.

mass.source: Printed fuselage nose fairing ~1.2 kg/m2 skin equivalent (0.8 kg/m)

main_wing.note: AutoSize Main Wing=true: jointly optimize span, root chord and taper using the current structurally closed iteration mass M2. Sizing enforces transition/stall, +1.5 g manoeuvre stall, and the configured sharp-edge vertical-gust stall screen. The upper root-chord bound is intentionally wide enough for the AVL-derived lift-curve slope to satisfy the gust screen. hardcoded_span_m, root_chord_m and taper_ratio remain the seed/fallback values. Set false to use them exactly.

horizontal_tail.note: AutoSize Horizontal Tail=true: jointly optimize span, root chord and taper from actual aircraft stability/control/structural requirements. target_tail_volume_coefficient is now a calibration reference for the screening aerodynamic derivatives, not a hard minimum. Set false to use hardcoded_span_m, root_chord_m and taper_ratio exactly.

vertical_tail.note: AutoSize Vertical Tail=true: jointly optimize fin height, root chord and taper from actual directional stability/control/structural requirements. target_vertical_tail_volume_coefficient is now a calibration reference for the screening aerodynamic derivatives, not a hard minimum. Set false to use hardcoded_span_m, root_chord_m and taper_ratio exactly.

propulsion.note: Lift-prop cruise CdA split with printed teardrop motor fairings: blade 0.0085 + motor/mount 0.0030 = 0.0115 m2 total (was ~0.0165).

component_mass_overrides.note: Dedupe: spar joiners are separate carbon joiners; harness is wiring_harness_pdb.

component_positions.note: With packaging_layout.enabled, battery/FC/H2 xyz are overwritten by rule-based placement; lift_row_center_x_m remains user-controlled.

packaging_layout.note: energy_bay_order: fuel_cell_forward | hydrogen_forward (mode auto sweeps both). cb_battery_order: battery_forward | control_box_forward (X order of CB/battery on the shared top shelf). component_axial_m is the X gap between non-nose components (also sizes FC–H₂ gap when midbody_length_mode is auto). Payload+Cube in nose; CB+battery sit on top in X tandem (first flush with forward energy host front; second axial behind); dual PDBs min-OD searched.

flight_envelope.note: Non-aerobatic inspection-aircraft screen: 45 deg bank corresponds to ~1.41 g, so +1.5 g provides operational manoeuvre margin. -0.5 g covers unloading/gust response without implying aerobatics. Structure remains screened at +3.0 g. Gust screen uses 5 m/s lateral and +/-2 m/s vertical step gusts for 2 s, including a combined lateral+upward case.

tail_autosizing.note: A 10% control safety factor tightens trim and elevator/rudder reserve limits during tail optimization. Tail volume coefficients are calibration references only; selected Vh/Vv are outputs. Normal-run 6-DOF remains an independent validation layer.

aerodynamic_derivatives.note: AVL mode automatically exports the current wing/HT/VT geometry and runs AVL for every geometry/mass state requested by the coupled sizing model. Set mode='approximate' to use the internal screening derivative assumptions only.

avl.fidelity_note: AVL derivatives use the lifting surfaces and control surfaces. Stall, viscous drag, propeller/VTOL flow interaction and separated flow remain in the existing dedicated model/screening methods.
